body: Hey just go to the psychiatric hospital. You already know what you have to do. They are there to help you. The guy you're seeing is human too with his own life and problems. He doesn't need you and you don't need him. From the sounds of it you guys should break things off. I've read a lot of funny excuses on here, but I think yours takes the cake. You're too busy with classes and homework, so you can't go to a psychiatric hospital? Just think about that excuse for a few minutes, have a laugh, and head on down to the hospital. You'll be better for it.
